observable_evidence: fixture inputs and fake tool states
process exit code and structured validator result
git branch, HEAD, diff, and modified files
non_observable_evidence: model reasoning that is not emitted by a component
targets.trace_dependency: Only when the component contract explicitly requires a trace

targets.unknown_condition: A required evidence record is missing
targets.infra_error_condition: The component could not produce evidence because its execution environment failed
